title: Unity Beauty POS — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Pressed Compact. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pressed Compact
options.lineage: matte-black professional makeup compacts: pressed pans, engraved shade numbers
options.thesis: Every product is a pan in a matte case; a sale is the swatch you lift from it.
options.viewport: Kassa: matte charcoal case rail on the left, the cart as a column of swatch strips with engraved numerals, the blush Checkout pan pressed into the payment panel.
options.risk: Turns into a cosmetics-ad costume if pans go glossy or the blush spreads beyond actions.

raised.raise: Quantity and stock bars encode exact counts against the low-stock line, never decoration.
List headers name the span in view (#000120–#000150, A–K) as you scroll.
The order number is the only headline on orders, Tekpe cards and the printed sheet.
Every numeral is tabular and right-aligned, so prices and totals read as columns.

options.label: Taekbae Waybill
options.thesis: Every screen is a waybill: boxed fields, monumental sort numbers, a barcode band.
options.viewport: Kassa as a live waybill: boxed fields for customer and payment, the cart as numbered rows, the order total set like a sort code.
options.risk: Familiar: it is where logistics tools land, and can read cold and warehouse-like for a beauty brand.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground; the one bright color is always something you can press.
options.viewport: Single column of soft cards with a persistent bottom bar; the blush appears only on actions.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on phones; loses on counter density and has no Unity Beauty character.
options.risk: Generic: close to every app template, and soft cards waste desktop space.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Each screen is a decision point with one message per band and monumental numbers.
options.viewport: Tekpe and Kassa as signage bands: the next action and the order number at monumental scale.
options.case: Strong clarity for Tekpe and totals; the yellow fights the client's pinned blush palette.
options.risk: Pinned colors would have to replace the yellow, which removes the system's core.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.thesis: A vertical staff where shape is direction and length is exact duration.
options.case: Fuses poorly: staff do not read dance scores, and symmetry fights a cart-plus-panel task.
options.kept: Exact proportional encoding: bar length is a true count.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.thesis: Black text to a fixed measure, guide words naming the span you are in.
options.viewport: Columns of entries under guide words.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a reading world for a scanning task; cream serif is off-brand.
options.kept: Guide words: headers name the range currently in view.
options.risk: Bookish and slow at a counter.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Every artifact gets a catalog number; navigate by number.
options.viewport: A black field with one catalog number as headline.
options.case: Fuses poorly: coded color strips hide product names staff need to read.
options.kept: The order number as the one and only headline.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Dense barcode columns and tabular numerals in pure black and white.
options.viewport: A wall of barcode bars with packed numbers.
options.case: Fuses poorly: strobing black and white is hostile for all-day counter work.
options.risk: Exhausting to look at for eight hours.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean admin POS: white cards, gray sidebar, blush primary buttons.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, product search, cart table and a totals card, as most POS tools ship.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any admin template by design.
